turns.user: Inverse-design a printable mortar: 28-day compressive strength >= 40 MPa and static yield stress between 1 and 4 kPa, minimising the clinker fraction. Search space: OPC required 0.5-1.0, silica fume 0-0.15, limestone powder 0-0.3, w/b 0.28-0.45. Run without asking.
turns.text:
I’ll run the inverse design over your bounds, minimising the OPC fraction, then check the candidates’ predictions and evidence for printability.
The first search returned a low-OPC candidate, but its median yield stress falls below your target. I’ll tighten the yield-stress screening and explicitly search blends containing silica fume before selecting a candidate.
**The searches did not establish a mix that reliably meets both targets.** The lowest-clinker candidate returned failed both targets on independent median prediction.

Binder fractions are by mass; predictions are **q50 [q10, q90]**:

| Candidate | OPC / silica fume / limestone | w/b | Compressive strength, MPa | Static yield stress, Pa |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Lowest clinker returned | 0.55 / 0.15 / 0.30 | 0.421 | 36.7 [18.9, 58.1] | 550 [15, 4574] |
| Stronger alternative | 0.70 / 0 / 0.30 | 0.302 | 44.3 [26.1, 67.7] | 945 [30, 4900] |

The stricter search found no candidates before automatically relaxing its probability thresholds. Optimiser and independent predictions also differed, so neither candidate should be accepted as compliant. Neither independent prediction extrapolated beyond the training ranges.

Defaults used: s/b = 1.50, moist curing, `comp_cube50`, no admixtures, and static yield stress immediately after discharge. The tool’s clinker objective treats OPC fraction as the clinker proxy.

Published evidence includes [RFA-50](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2025.144187), reporting **44.6 MPa at 28 days** and **1760 Pa** static yield stress. Its unspecified “other powder” prevents treating it as compliant with your material bounds.

**Recommendation:** retain the stronger alternative as an experimental starting point. Yield-stress predictions provide order-of-magnitude guidance given their broad uncertainty. Printability remains unverified without print geometry and schedule; final selection requires experiments.
